  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateCityCapacity

## 2. Owner-create endpoint pipeline: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`

Authorized by `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. Linear pipeline of steps (each `class:` listed below):

```
validate        -> ValidateNewOwner
uniqueTelephone -> ValidateUniqueTelephone
uniqueHousehold -> ValidateUniqueHousehold
cityCapacity    -> ValidateCityCapacity
dailyLimit      -> ValidateDailyOwnerLimit
applyHousehold  -> ApplySharedHousehold      (govern: transaction)
build           -> BuildOwner                (govern: transaction)
save            -> SaveOwner                 (govern: transaction)
audit           -> AuditOwnerCreated         (govern: transaction)
bulkWarning     -> FlagBulkSignup            (govern: transaction)

```

(Full YAML with comments was read; the sequence/next-links are as above.)

## 3. Membership tier logic — THE KEY FILE

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`

The `@Entity` Owner (extends `Person`, table `owners`). Persisted columns include `address`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, `registration_date` (`registrationDate`), `customer_code` (`customerCode`), **`household_id` (`householdId`)**, `namesake_count` (`namesakeCount`), plus a `@Transient boolean bulkSignupWarning` and eager `Set<Pet> pets`.

**Current membership tier method (lines 172-177):**
```java
@Transient
public String getMembershipTier() {
    boolean uniqueName = this.namesakeCount != null && this.namesakeCount == 0;
    boolean hasEmail = this.email != null && !this.email.isBlank();
    return (uniqueName && hasEmail) ? "SILVER" : "BRONZE";
}
```

Only ever returns `"SILVER"` or `"BRONZE"`. **There is NO `"GOLD"` logic and nothing here counts household members.** Other transient derived getters: `getDisplayName()`, `getInitials()`, `getMembershipNumber()` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), `getLocality()` (fixed Sydney/Melbourne/Brisbane -> NSW/VIC/QLD table, else UNKNOWN), `isBulkSignupWarning()`.

**Important gap for your edit:** `householdId` is stored on the entity, but the entity holds no household-member count. To compute GOLD "when the household has 3+ members", you would need the member count at serialization time — either stored on the owner (like `namesakeCount`) or computed via the repository. `getMembershipTier()` currently has no repository access (it's a plain entity getter).

## 4. Household / membershipTier in the OpenAPI schema

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (lines 1991-2140)

- `OwnerFields` schema (editable input): firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone, email, registrationDate, and **`sharesHousehold`** (write-only boolean). Required: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone.
- `Owner` schema (allOf OwnerFields + read-only): id, displayName, initials, customerCode, membershipNumber, **`householdId`**, namesakeCount, **`membershipTier`**, locality, bulkSignupWarning, pets.
- `membershipTier` description (line 2116): *"'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'."* — **This spec text does NOT mention GOLD**, so the schema description also needs updating if you add GOLD.

**ValidateNewOwner.java** — First step. Binds `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (no `@Valid`). Publishes `Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another
            owner has the same last name at the same address (same household); otherwise
            such a create is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that share a household (same last name at the same address) when created with 'sharesHousehold' true. Owners not in a shared household have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier, 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'

## What I changed

The `membershipTier` is a derived field with no repository access, so GOLD (which depends on a household member **count**) is computed by a pipeline step that stamps the count onto the owner before the response is built — mirroring exactly how `bulkSignupWarning` already works.

1. **`Owner.java`** (entity)
   - Added a `@Transient int householdSize` field with getter/setter.
   - Updated `getMembershipTier()` to return `"GOLD"` when `householdSize >= 3`, falling through to the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules otherwise.

2. **`FlagHouseholdSize.java`** (new function class)
   - Counts owners sharing the owner's `householdId` (owners with no household id get size 1) and sets `householdSize` on the loaded owner.

3. **Pipeline wiring** — inserted the `householdSize` step into both:
   - `owners.POST.yml` (create — after save, under `transaction`), and
   - `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` (fetch — under `readonly-transaction`),
   so the tier reflects the current household on both create and GET. The test asserts via `GET /api/owners/{id}`, and computing dynamically also means **every** member of a 3+ household reads as GOLD, not just the one that tipped it over.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `membershipTier` description to document the GOLD rule (keeps the generated DTO/spec in sync; MapStruct needs no change since it maps by name).

### Why dynamic rather than storing a tier at create time
Members 1 and 2 only become GOLD-eligible once member 3 joins. Storing a fixed tier at creation would leave the earlier members stale. Counting the household at response time keeps all members consistent and matches the spec's "household has 3+ members" phrasing. Owners outside a shared household (`householdId` null) default to size 1, so no existing BRONZE/SILVER behavior regresses, and the list endpoint is untouched.

One scoping note: I left `GET /api/owners` (the list/page endpoint) as-is — it has no household-size step, so listed owners fall back to the prior SILVER/BRONZE derivation. There's no test or spec requirement for GOLD in the list view; say the word if you'd like it reflected there too.
